notes.title: Orcen Axe is now released and available!
notes.content:
[b]Orcen Axe releases... NOW![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43135514/01a86b89b8b5a571920554f2a9c4d3dae8d98a94.gif[/img]

As the orc Drak, you'll square off against wizards and dragons, save a kingdom, and maybe find your lost love. Death didn't stop you, and getting necromanced back to life only made you stronger (and grumpier).

Indeed, these old orc boots were made for axe battlin'!

notes.title: Update: Showing currently bound keys
notes.content: There's now a display in the upper right corner that shows the keys that are currently set for jump and attack. No more keyboard key confusion! (I'm often very confused about keyboards and keys and computers and my life in general.)

notes.title: Free Demo!
notes.content: The demo of Orcen Axe is now available. Let's see how you'll handle that axe!

notes.title: Orcen Axe: Pretty much all finished up!
notes.content:
Orcen Axe is almost ready for release! It's going to come out on Nintendo Switch's eShop on Nov 8th '22, and a few weeks after that, it'll release here on Steam, too.

The game is a Treasure Hunter Man 2 spin-off in a way. If you liked that game, chances are you'll like this one as well.

See you soon~
